# 获取远程开门配置
##### 简要描述

- ChannelID固定为1

**XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| RemoteDoorOpenSwitch | boolean | 远程开门开关,false-禁用;true-启用<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| AssociateQRCode | boolean | 是否关联二维码,false-否;true-是<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature | boolean | 是否关联访客体温,false-否;true-是<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
GET /FaceReco/1/RemoteOpenDoorCfg HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: eb546ae9-a989-4af1-89ef-b9844c3a7e3e
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Length:271
Content-Type:application/xml
Connection:close

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<RemoteOpenDoorCfg Version="1.0">
<RemoteDoorOpenSwitch>true</RemoteDoorOpenSwitch>
<AssociateQRCode>true</AssociateQRCode>
<AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature>true</AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature>
</RemoteOpenDoorCfg>
```

GET HTTP请求示例
GET /FaceReco/1/RemoteOpenDoorCfg HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.26.10
Accept: _/_
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: d7e5cf04-2a97-4b87-801a-38bfcc240c0a
Host: 192.168.1.100
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive

GET HTTP响应示例
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.0
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 124

\<RemoteOpenDoorCfg>
    \<RemoteDoorOpenSwitch>true\</RemoteDoorOpenSwitch>
    \<AssociateQRCode>true\</AssociateQRCode>
    \<AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature>true\</AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature>
\</RemoteOpenDoorCfg>

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceReco/ChannelID/RemoteOpenDoorCfg` 

##### 请求方式

- get
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
[]

```
